findings.snippet: **Needs from you:** which date should I use?
findings.why: this turn declares -Ask offer, but asks Shiv a direct question. A not-blocking declaration sets awaiting_reply false, so the question is dropped from the blocked-on-human digest and no later run re-raises it (#618) -- it would reach nobody. Use -Ask blocking if you need the answer to continue; reword to a statement if you do not; -DisableGuard G14 if you really mean it
